aboutText: RS Electrical VIC is a licensed electrical service provider based in Truganina, Melbourne. We specialise in a wide range of home electrical services, including safety inspections, smoke alarm installation, and switchboard upgrades. Our team is dedicated to providing reliable and professional service to homeowners, landlords, and property managers in Truganina and surrounding areas. With a commitment to quality workmanship, we ensure your electrical needs are met safely and efficiently.
servicesText: We offer a full spectrum of electrical services tailored to residential and commercial clients in Truganina. From routine maintenance to complex installations, our licensed electricians deliver safe and efficient solutions. Our services include everything from lighting and power points to solar battery installs and CCTV systems.
